_what: One record per typeface in fonts/, read off that family's own METADATA.pb in github.com/google/fonts by tools/pull-foundry.py. Nothing in this file was typed. The designer line is verbatim from the record, including where a record credits a studio rather than a person.
_licence: The licence is which directory of that repository the family lives in, cross-checked against the licence field inside its own record. Both have to agree or the pull refuses.
